# NEW 2026-11-18 fourth round D4 (settling reclaimed provinces, oe_trc_). Generated by gen_round4_reclaim.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Location scope. Removes this track's settlement modifiers.
oe_trc_clear_mods = { if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_a } remove_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_a } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_b } remove_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_b } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_bp } remove_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_bp } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_c } remove_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_c } if = { limit = { has_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_d } remove_location_modifier = oe_trc_settle_d } }

# Location scope; scope:oe_trc_byz = BYZ (from the hidden worker oe_trc.9). Settles one batch location by
# var:oe_trc_choice on BYZ and clears its marks. Option d settles only Orthodox locations; the rest get a.
oe_trc_settle_loc = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_batch } remove_variable = oe_trc_batch }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } remove_variable = oe_trc_pending }
    oe_trc_clear_mods = yes
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_trc_byz scope:oe_trc_byz = { var:oe_trc_choice ?= 2 } }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_trc_byz = { oe_ti_pronoia_allowed = yes } }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_trc_settle_bp years = 5 mode = replace }
        }
        else = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_trc_settle_b years = 5 mode = replace } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_trc_byz scope:oe_trc_byz = { var:oe_trc_choice ?= 3 } }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_trc_settle_c years = 5 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_trc_byz scope:oe_trc_byz = { var:oe_trc_choice ?= 4 } dominant_religion = religion:orthodox }
        add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_trc_settle_d years = 5 mode = replace }
    }
    else = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_trc_settle_a years = 5 mode = replace } }
}

# Location scope; scope:oe_trc_byz = BYZ. Puts the location into the batch of the next settlement event.
oe_trc_mark = {
    set_variable = oe_trc_batch
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_trc_byz }
        scope:oe_trc_byz = { change_variable = { name = oe_trc_n add = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { dominant_religion = religion:orthodox }
            scope:oe_trc_byz = { change_variable = { name = oe_trc_orth_n add = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Removes the batch marks of an event that was never answered.
oe_trc_unmark_all = {
    every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_batch } remove_variable = oe_trc_batch }
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_batch } remove_variable = oe_trc_batch } }
}

# BYZ scope. Takes the pending locations of one historical region (BYZ land first, then theme land), counts them and
# opens the settlement event oe_trc.1. Closes the gate when nothing is pending.
oe_trc_pick = {
    save_scope_as = oe_trc_byz
    oe_trc_unmark_all = yes
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc_n value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc_orth_n value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc_region value = -1 }
    random_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } save_scope_as = oe_trc_first }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_trc_first } }
        random_subject = {
            limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } }
            random_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } save_scope_as = oe_trc_first }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_trc_first }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc_region value = scope:oe_trc_first.var:oe_trc_pending }
        every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending exists = scope:oe_trc_byz var:oe_trc_pending = scope:oe_trc_byz.var:oe_trc_region } oe_trc_mark = yes }
        every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } every_owned_location = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending exists = scope:oe_trc_byz var:oe_trc_pending = scope:oe_trc_byz.var:oe_trc_region } oe_trc_mark = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc_busy months = 12 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_trc } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_trc value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_trc add = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_trc.1
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_open } remove_variable = oe_trc_open }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly while the gate oe_trc_open is set (on_action oe_trc_byz_pulse). At most one settlement event a
# month; waits while one is open and while the '旧省归来' chain of gen_territory_outer.py is open.
oe_trc_byz_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_trc_busy }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_tw_ret_busy }
        }
        oe_trc_pick = yes
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev mod buttons and console, BYZ scope)
# Marks the 3 most populous BYZ locations of one historical region (not the capital district) as former provinces that
# are waiting to be settled. Their old settlement modifiers are removed so the test can be repeated.
oe_trc_test_mark = {
    save_scope_as = oe_trc_byz
    random_owned_location = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region NOT = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 1 } }
        save_scope_as = oe_trc_tl
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_trc_tl }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc_test_region value = scope:oe_trc_tl.var:oe_theme_region }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region var:oe_theme_region = scope:oe_trc_byz.var:oe_trc_test_region }
            order_by = population
            max = 3
            check_range_bounds = no
            oe_trc_clear_mods = yes
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_province value = var:oe_theme_region }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc_pending value = var:oe_theme_region }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_trc_test_region
    }
    else = {
        capital ?= {
            oe_trc_clear_mods = yes
            set_variable = { name = oe_tw_former_province value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc_pending value = 0 }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_trc_open } } set_variable = oe_trc_open }
}
# Opens the settlement event now (marks 3 locations first when nothing is pending; ignores the open-event wait).
oe_trc_test_fire = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } }
            NOT = { any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes any_owned_location = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } } }
        }
        oe_trc_test_mark = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_busy } remove_variable = oe_trc_busy }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_trc_open } } set_variable = oe_trc_open }
    oe_trc_pick = yes
}
# Clears every pending and batch mark, the settlement modifiers on BYZ land and the BYZ variables of this track.
oe_trc_test_reset = {
    every_owned_location = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending has_variable = oe_trc_batch oe_trc_settled = yes } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } remove_variable = oe_trc_pending }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_batch } remove_variable = oe_trc_batch }
        oe_trc_clear_mods = yes
    }
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } every_owned_location = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending has_variable = oe_trc_batch } } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending } remove_variable = oe_trc_pending } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_batch } remove_variable = oe_trc_batch } } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_open } remove_variable = oe_trc_open } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_busy } remove_variable = oe_trc_busy } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_choice } remove_variable = oe_trc_choice } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_region } remove_variable = oe_trc_region } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_n } remove_variable = oe_trc_n } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc_orth_n } remove_variable = oe_trc_orth_n }
}
